messages.author: 4184023bb084c468
messages.subject: problem integrating with cytoscape.js
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to integrate shiny with cytoscape.js, basing my code on Jeff Allen's nice d3 example here:

http://trestletechnology.net/2012/12/reconstruct-gene-networks/

I'm running into a problem that when I click on a node in my cytoscape.js network, I should see a console message telling me which node I've clicked on, but instead cytoscape tells me that I've clicked on the background of the graph, not a node. 

Here you can see that problem in action:
http://cloud.bioconductor.org:3838/cyshiny/

Open a javascript console. Wait for the graph to setle down, click on a node. You'll see "click on background" in the console.

Here is how it is supposed to work, a miminal example that is just a plain static HTML file, no shiny involved:

http://cloud.bioconductor.org:3838/cyshiny/standalone.html

If you click on a node there, you'll see something like "clicked on X3055 " in the console.

So, I started looking for differences between those two files. I took the source obtained by running "View source" on
http://cloud.bioconductor.org:3838/cyshiny/

and started commenting things out until it worked (at some point I also needed to hardcode the data so it wasn't coming from shiny). 

The result is:

http://cloud.bioconductor.org:3838/cyshiny/all.html

If you click on a node, you'll see its name in the console. Yay!

So the last thing I had commented out was:

<div class="span8">

And maybe I am mistaken, but that did not seem to have a closing div?

Anyway, I thought I had solved the problem. So I went back to 

http://cloud.bioconductor.org:3838/cyshiny/

took the source of it and put it in a new file and just removed that span8 div. The result should be:

http://cloud.bioconductor.org:3838/cyshiny/stillbroken.html

but that doesn't display for some reason in my shiny server. So you'll have to download the shiny app and run it locally:

https://s3.amazonaws.com/cyshiny/cyshiny.tar.gz

Then you can see the problem here:

http://localhost:8100/stillbroken.html

Clicking on a node is still broken and the border around the graph is in the wrong place.

At this point I am lost....it looks like shiny is putting something in the UI it generates that is breaking the graph's ability to know where you are when you click in it.

Can someone help?

Thanks!
Dan

messages.author: 4184023bb084c468
messages.subject: Re: problem integrating with cytoscape.js
parts:
OK, I sort of have a fix for this...or at least a way to make it work. I'm going to need some help from the shiny folks though to make this sustainable.

if I go to my app and view the source:

http://cloud.bioconductor.org:3838/cyshiny/

Then I take that and apply this diff:

http://cloud.bioconductor.org:3838/cyshiny/diff.txt

(text below)


What I end up with works. 

I tried to set it up as:

http://cloud.bioconductor.org:3838/cyshiny/works.html

but that does not render for some reason.

However if you run the app locally:

http://localhost:8100/works.html

This works in that you can click on nodes and see their names. But it messes up the formatting of the shiny input widgets. 

This suggests that having the page in two columns was somehow throwing off the cytoscape widget.

So....what's the best way to fix this at the shiny level? I can work around it by using a custom HTML UI but I'd rather not do that.

Thanks!
Dan
